data.cultural_impact: The name Bhaveshan holds deep cultural significance, as it references the Hindu concept of the Sky (Bhava) being the supreme ruler or God (Isha). This connection highlights the reverence for the celestial bodies and their influence on everyday life as well as the belief in a higher power controlling the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: V Gibas, Hindu Dharma Acharya, explains the spiritual significance of Bhaveshan as referencing the unique connection each individual has with the divine, embodied by the concept of 'Sky God' or Bhagavan. It serves as an inspiring reminder to look beyond material pursuits and seek the infinite expanse of knowledge, truth, and consciousness - the abode of the god Bhagavan, carried within each person. The name conveys a powerful sense of awe, wonder, and spiritual dignifedness.

historical_references.reference: Bhaveshan was an important Jain Tirthankara (religious teacher) of the 22nd cycle of Jainism. His teachings were particularly influential in the northern Indian states of Rajasthan, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
historical_references.context: Jainism is an ancient Indian religion that emphasizes non-violence, self-control, and renunciation. Tirthankaras are the spiritual leaders of Jainism, considered to be the human teachers who show the path to moksha (liberation). Bhaveshan is one of the 24 Tirthankaras of Jainism, also known as Bhagavan Mahavira's predecessors.

historical_references.reference: Bhaveshan is also known as Mahavira Swami, and is considered an incarnation of the god Vishnu in Hinduism. He is believed to have lived during the Treta Yuga, and is considered to be the preceptor of the sacred hymns of the Rigveda, the oldest sacred text in Hinduism.
historical_references.context: In Hinduism, gods and goddesses are believed to periodically descend to Earth in various forms, to help maintain the balance of the universe. Bhaveshan, as an incarnation of Vishnu, played a significant role in Hindu mythology at this time, and is revered as a divine teacher and sage.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Hindu name 'Bhaveshan' is gaining popularity in modern contexts, particularly in astrology, spirituality, and tech industries. On Instagram, astrologers and spiritual gurus often use the name as a handle or in their bio to establish their expertise and authenticity. On YouTube, there are numerous channels dedicated to Bhagavan Bhaveshan, a popular Hindu deity, where devotees can watch prayers, bhajans, and learn about various aspects of Hinduism. Lastly, there are several mobile apps, such as 'Bhaveshan Astrology' and 'Bhagwan Bhaveshan', which provide astrological predictions, horoscope readings, and spiritual guidance to users.
